name: workspace-chameleon
description: Like a chameleon adapting to its habitat, your IDE automatically switches color themes and visual accents based on the active folder or project.

workspaceChameleon.enabled.description: Enable or disable automatic workspace theme switching.

enumDescriptions: Apply only Color Themes without modifying Titlebar/Statusbar accent colors.
Apply both Color Theme (syntax & editor) and Titlebar/Statusbar Accent colors.
Apply only Titlebar/Statusbar Accent colors (preserves your global syntax theme).
workspaceChameleon.mode.description: Determines whether to switch full editor themes, titlebar/statusbar accent colors, or both.

workspaceChameleon.autoAssignFromInstall.description: When no rule exists for a folder, automatically calculate and assign a deterministic theme from your installed extensions library based on the folder/project name, and save it.

workspaceChameleon.autoGeneratePalette.description: When accent mode is active and no rule exists for a folder, automatically generate a harmonious accent color based on the folder path.

workspaceChameleon.showStatusBarItem.description: Show interactive Chameleon indicator and quick menu in the status bar.

workspaceChameleon.rules.description: List of folder matching rules and their corresponding theme or accent color.

path.description: Absolute folder path or glob pattern (e.g. 'd:/projects/app1', '**/joomla-*', '*client*').

theme.description: Name of the installed color theme to apply (e.g. 'Tokyo Night', 'Catppuccin Mocha').

iconTheme.description: Optional icon theme to apply for this folder.

accentColor.description: HEX color code for Titlebar, Activity Bar, and Status Bar (e.g. '#7952d6').

colorCustomizations.description: Raw VS Code workbench.colorCustomizations object for advanced customization.
